briefing: President Trump named Director of National Intelligence Jay Clayton as the administration's AI czar, an added title, and Clayton will head an AI task force. The move puts federal AI policy coordination under the intelligence chief (Politico, CNBC, Reuters, The Washington Post).

Treasury Secretary Bessent said the AI industry must own its risks and find solutions. The remarks are a signal worth watching for Treasury's posture on AI, including in financial services (Bloomberg).
A New York Times piece examines who should be held responsible when AI systems behave unexpectedly or harmfully. The question bears on emerging debates over AI liability (The New York Times).

articles.title: Implementing the Federal Reserve Board's Responsibilities Under the GENIUS Act
articles.snippet: Proposed Rule — Federal Reserve System — The Board of Governors of the Federal Reserve System (Board) proposes to issue regulations to implement the Guiding and Establishing National Innovation for U.S. Stablecoins Act (GENIUS Act) with respect to Board-supervised permitted payment stablecoin issuers (PPSIs) and certain other entities that are subject to the Board's jurisdiction.
